title: Floating Machi Koro-style central illustration spec
purpose: Reusable specification for the central subject illustration that will be composited onto a blank Machi Koro-style card furniture template. The generated art should reproduce the iconic floating miniature look while adapting the subject to recognizable contemporary Moscow.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the central content illustration to be pasted onto an existing blank purple card template.
integration_context.background_requirement: Use a genuinely transparent background. Include no sky, header, footer, card furniture, text, coin, icon, frame, or backdrop.
integration_context.text_policy: The illustration must contain no text whatsoever: no letters, numbers, names, prices, labels, signs, logos, graffiti, license-plate characters, or pseudo-writing on any surface.
integration_context.card_relationship: The art should sit like a floating miniature object or sticker inside the middle of the card, leaving generous empty space around it.
integration_context.central_positioning: The subject should be centered and self-contained with wide transparent margins and no clipping.

style_goal.primary_rule: Match the cute, simplified tabletop-game illustration language of the original Machi Koro establishment art without copying a complete existing illustration.
style_goal.secondary_rule: Make the architecture unmistakably reminiscent of the Moscow-City business district while keeping it compact and toy-like.
style_goal.core_formula: Cute simplified floating board-game miniature plus a recognizable cluster of Moscow-City-inspired glass towers.

what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.miniature_scene_feel: A small isolated toy-like scene, almost like a board-game token, sticker, or floating diorama rather than a full landscape.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.shape_language: Large clean shapes, simple geometry, compact clustered forms, and slightly exaggerated silhouettes.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.perspective: Loose playful three-quarter perspective. The buildings face slightly right, clearly showing their front and right sides.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.linework: Clear outlines or sharp separations between forms, with sparse interior detail lines.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.shading: Simple graphic shading using one or two darker tones; no realistic lighting model.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.materials: Communicate glass and metal through color blocks, highlights, and silhouette rather than texture or architectural visualization.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.detail_density: Low to moderate so every tower remains readable at small card size.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.silhouette_priority: The clustered skyline silhouette must read instantly and feel iconic.
what_machi_koro_art_looks_like.scene_boundary: The towers stand on one small self-contained plaza slab and do not blend into any background.

visual_composition.occupancy: The content illustration should occupy a compact central area with wide transparent air around it.
visual_composition.shape: A compact cluster of three to five towers, with one tall twisting glass tower and a few shorter distinctive neighbors.
visual_composition.floating_behavior: The scene visually floats in open space and does not connect to the card's lower skyline strip.
visual_composition.base: A small stylized oval or angular business-plaza slab belonging entirely to the miniature.
visual_composition.background: Fully transparent; no skyline, sky, clouds, horizon, streetscape, or distant scenery.

warm_accents: tiny warm plaza lights only where helpful
palette.overall_brightness: clean and readable, with restrained violet accents that harmonize with the purple card without washing the whole scene purple

general: Reduce the subject to a compact iconic miniature.
Choose only the few details needed for recognition.
Keep all forms chunky and readable.
Keep generous transparent margin around the full silhouette.
building_specific: Use a cluster resembling Moscow-City: one tall twisting or faceted glass tower, one curved sail-like tower, and two shorter stepped glass towers.
Buildings must face slightly right, showing front and right sides in a readable three-quarter view.
Windows are simplified color grids and broad reflective panels, never tiny realistic window detail.
Rooflines and crowns are few, distinct, and unclipped.
All facades and plaza surfaces are completely free of writing, branding, emblems, and text-like marks.
environment_specific: Use only a small clean plaza base with a few geometric planters or tiny trees.
Do not include cars, people, billboards, street signs, or a surrounding city.

content.subject: A stylized miniature cluster of Moscow-City-inspired business towers representing an IT company.
content.description: A compact group of sleek modern glass skyscrapers with recognizable Moscow-City visual cues: a tall twisting faceted tower, a curved sail-like tower, and several stepped blue-violet glass towers arranged on one small plaza slab.
content.desired_read: A successful modern Russian IT company headquartered in Moscow-City, immediately readable as a premium purple major establishment.
recognition_details: one dominant twisting or faceted glass tower with a tapering crown
one curved sail-like glass tower beside it
two or three shorter stepped towers with broad blue and violet reflective panels
compact shared podium or plaza base
a few simplified amber-lit windows for warmth
content.miniature_base: A small angular gray plaza podium with two or three tiny geometric planters, fully contained inside the floating illustration.
simplify: glass facades into broad alternating blue-gray, lavender, and teal panels
tower shapes into bold readable silhouettes with sparse window grids
the district into one compact cluster rather than a full skyline
omit: all text and text-like content, including letters, numbers, company names, signs, logos, labels, graffiti, license plates, and pseudo-glyphs
full-card composition, skyline background, sky, clouds, city streets, people, cars, billboards, and branded architecture
photorealism, architectural-visualization detail, cinematic lighting, gradients that look glossy or corporate, and dense facade texture
content.target_impression: The original Machi Koro illustrator's playful miniature language applied to a recognizable Moscow-City cluster: ambitious, tech-oriented, expensive, slightly imposing, and harmonious with a purple card.

anti_patterns: Do not generate a full card.
Do not generate sky, clouds, footer, or any fixed card furniture.
Do not create a realistic architectural rendering.
Do not create a full cityscape background.
Do not make the scene connect visually to the bottom of the card.
Do not generate any letters, numbers, words, labels, logos, signage, graffiti, license-plate characters, or pseudo-text.
Do not clip the tower crowns, plaza base, or shadows.
Do not show the buildings straight-on or facing left.
final_prompt_summary: Generate only a small floating miniature cluster of Moscow-City-inspired business towers for the central illustration of a purple Machi Koro-style establishment card called IT company. Use a genuinely transparent background with wide empty margins. Arrange three to five sleek towers on one compact angular plaza podium: one dominant twisting or faceted glass tower with a tapering crown, one curved sail-like glass tower, and two or three shorter stepped glass towers. Make the cluster unmistakably reminiscent of Moscow-City while remaining an original simplified composition. Face the buildings slightly to the right so the front and right sides are visible in a playful three-quarter perspective. Use chunky toy-like geometry, clean outlines, sparse facade detail, broad blue-gray, smoky lavender, muted teal, silver, and deep violet glass panels, simple graphic shading, and only a few amber-lit windows. The result must be an isolated board-game miniature, not a skyline or full card. Include no text or text-like marks anywhere: no letters, numbers, names, prices, signs, labels, logos, branding, graffiti, license plates, or pseudo-writing. Include no people, cars, billboards, streets, sky, clouds, footer, frame, coin, icon, or background scene. Keep every tower crown and the entire plaza base fully visible and unclipped.
